title: And oglings of the barmaids with whom his father flirted,
html_source: Remember that his father is married, and that he is with Stephen in all of these encounters… Pretty awkward for Stephen…

anchor.text: and oglings of the barmaids with whom his father flirted,
anchor.prefix: gn of his father’s drinking bout of the night before by moving his chair and coughing. One humiliation had succeeded another—the false smiles of the market sellers, the curvetings
anchor.suffix: the compliments and encouraging words of his father’s friends. They had told him that he had a great look of his grandfather and Mr Dedalus had agreed that he was an ugly likeness
